thread:
mina (Partnerships): Quick sync: NovaWeights wants to list quantized variants on GCP Marketplace EU + run a co-sell with SI partner Solvo. They sent an addendum asking for regional download rights, reseller commission, and a 30-day payment lag.
sam (Legal): Addendum redlines show two issues: (1) they expect marketplaces to redistribute downloadable artifacts (we prefer hosted endpoints only), (2) no geo-blocking clause for embargoed countries. We'll need explicit non-sublicense language and provenance metadata.
ram (BizDev): Commercial ask: NovaWeights proposes 78/22 hosted split, 82/18 marketplace split, and 10% SI integration fee. Solvo requests a 30-day exclusivity in EU for joint announcements.
ops-bot: quick infra check: catalog changes required to tag "marketplace_downloadable" SKUs and enforce "download_allowed=false" for private/dedicated customers. Create ticket RD-OPS-9012.
mina (Partnerships): Proposal: (A) Offer hosted endpoints at 78/22. (B) For marketplaces, require a marketplace-specific addendum with provenance manifest + 30-day settlement via Redwood. (C) Accept 30-day marketing exclusivity if NovaFunds co-marketing budget covers PR.
sam (Legal): OK if NovaWeights updates addendum: include "no-sublicense without written consent", export-control warranty, geo-block manifest, and invoice flow: marketplace -> Redwood -> provider, net 30 days. We'll ask for sample tax docs for withholding.
nico (Marketing): 30-day exclusivity is fine conditionally — PR draft due T-10, embargo alignment with GCP listing. Require co-brand assets and partner quotes.
am (BizDev): I'll push for marketplace split to 80/20 and Solvo fee to 12%. Will request NovaWeights to update addendum ASAP.
mina (Partnerships): Actions: Ram to negotiate splits, Sam to request addendum changes, Ops to implement RD-OPS-9012 for SKU flags, Nico to prepare co-marketing checklist. Please update this thread by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
